content.title: Duke's Cameron Boozer Named 2026 ACC Tournament MVP
content.text: After being named ACC Player of the Year during the regular season, freshman Cameron Boozer became the 23rd Blue Devil to be crowned the ACC Basketball Tournament MVP. Boozer had two 20-and-10 double-doubles and averaged 20.0 points, 10.6 rebounds, and 5.6 assists in three games in the ACC tournament. He made 38.1% of his field goal attempts and 42.8% on three-pointers. In the Championship game against Virginia, he had 13 points, eight rebounds, eight assists, and a steal.
